description: This Java source file defines the ClientCharge entity class, which models a financial charge assigned to a client within the Fineract system. It includes fields for charge details, status, and methods for payment, waiver, and status management.

classes.name: ClientCharge
classes.description: Entity class representing a client's financial charge, including details about the charge, status, amount, payment, and waiver state, with methods for managing payments and status.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ClientCharge instance with specified client, charge, and command parameters.

methods.name: pay
methods.description: Method to record a payment against this charge, updating paid amounts and outstanding balance.

methods.name: undoPayment
methods.description: Reverts a payment, adjusting paid and outstanding amounts accordingly.

methods.name: waive
methods.description: Marks the charge as waived and updates amounts accordingly.

methods.name: undoWaiver
methods.description: Reverts a waiver, restoring amount waived and adjusting outstanding amounts.

methods.name: populateDerivedFields
methods.description: Sets amount-related fields based on charge calculation type and provided amount.

methods.name: isOnSpecifiedDueDate
methods.description: Checks whether the charge is due on a specified date.

methods.name: determineIfFullyPaid
methods.description: Determines whether the charge has been fully paid.

methods.name: calculateOutstanding
methods.description: Calculates the remaining outstanding amount for the charge.

methods.name: getDueLocalDate
methods.description: Returns the due date of the charge.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client associated with this charge.

methods.name: getCharge
methods.description: Returns the charge definition for this charge.

methods.name: getChargeTime
methods.description: Returns the charge time enum value.

methods.name: getDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date.

methods.name: getChargeCalculation
methods.description: Returns the calculation type enum value.

methods.name: isPenaltyCharge
methods.description: Indicates if the charge is a penalty.

methods.name: isPaid
methods.description: Indicates if the charge has been fully paid.

methods.name: isWaived
methods.description: Indicates if the charge has been waived.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Indicates if the charge is active.

methods.name: isNotActive
methods.description: Indicates if the charge is not active.

methods.name: getInactivationDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the charge was inactivated.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated client.

methods.name: getOfficeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the client's office.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the charge.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the monetary currency object.

methods.name: isPaidOrPartiallyPaid
methods.description: Checks whether the charge is paid or partially paid in the given currency.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the total amount of the charge as a Money object.

methods.name: getAmountPaid
methods.description: Returns the amount paid as a Money object.

methods.name: getAmountWaived
methods.description: Returns the amount waived as a Money object.

methods.name: getAmountWrittenOff
methods.description: Returns the amount written off as a Money object.

methods.name: getAmountOutstanding
methods.description: Returns the outstanding amount as a Money object.
